Name: Geto Suguru Custom NPC (From Jujutsu Kaisen S2)
Author: hanbweh
Description:
[b][u][size=3][img]https://i.imgur.com/WlnCMZO.png[/img]﻿﻿

Hi.
[/size]
[/u][/b]I got really inspired by the existing JJK character mods that I decided to make my own. This started as a personal, self-indulgent project but now I have decided to upload it. :D

[b]WARNING: HE IS FLIRTY. [/b]Though, not until around 6 hearts (I'm sorry) but yeah, his personality isn't really canon. 

This is my first time making a mod! So, please let me know if there are any bugs, especially the ones that directly affect the gameplay/experience.

He is [u]DATEABLE[/u] and [u]MARRIABLE[/u].
[u]BIRTHDAY: SPRING 3rd.[/u] (because February, according to Google, represents Spring)[i]
[/i]He appears in all festivals minus [u]trout derby, desert festival (only after marriage), festival of ice[/u] (though he still has a special line dialogue before the events), [u]night market[/u].
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]SVE[/url] (his placements in festivals)
[u]He has his own personal[/u] accept bouquet dialogue, accept pendant, and new lines if you talk to him after having your display judged in the Stardew Valley Fair [size=1][s](try displaying the mayor's purple pants and then talk to him)[/s][/size]

psst. if you like cat gojo and geto and would like to add them chonky bois into your game, check out my new mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27237/]Jujutsu Cats[/url]!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SGs9tOd.png[/img]
9/8/24 Update (ver 2.0.1):
- Fixed the baby not appearing in-game
- Added dialogues specifically for the night market

7/9/24 Update (ver 2.0.0):
- Added heart events (2 hearts, 4 hearts, 6 hearts, 8 hearts, 10 hearts)
- fixed his position in adventure guild, also his positions in festivals
- added some dialogue
- he appears in desert festival ONLY after marriage

- added custom furniture so now you can proudly hang Suguru's frame up on the wall and scream to the whole town that your spouse is The Geto Suguru


7/3/24 Update (ver 1.0.1): 
- Now compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23653?tab=description]Suguru Geto NPC (JJK)[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/185653977]kryptonimus[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21646]Suguru Geto NPC[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/183820785]meeppi3[/url]
- fixed his schedule (in Winter, but his schedule remains the same! Just made a little fix)
- added his kids retexture (now you can have his kids)
- added some new dialogue and fixed his marriage dialogue (sometimes he'd only return "...")
- Added Spouse Room and Spouse Patio! (finally)
- his sleeping sprite is now showing when he sleeps at night in the bed (after marriage)
- fixed his positions in Stardew events

6/29/24 mod released (ver 1.0.0)

[u]Love[/u]: Prismatic Shard,  sashimi, pancakes, ice cream, chocolate cake, cookies, maki roll, tea leaves, tea set, green tea

[u]Like[/u]: salad, wine, honey, maple bar, eggs, milk

[u]Neutral[/u]: ancient seed, artisan goods, flowers [size=1](not the foraged ones)[/size]

[u]Dislike[/u]: strange bun, artifact trove, bombs, minerals, fish, seed, forage (greens)

[u]Hate[/u]: trash [size=1](he won't accept it)[/size], monster loot, bait, fishing tackles

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gUrmlfN.png[/img]
He [b]finally[/b] has heart events (yay)

2 hearts: go to the forest any day except Saturday and Sunday between 11 AM and 3 PM on a sunny day. Make sure it's not Winter.

4 hearts: must have seen the previous event. Go to the forest any day except Saturday and Sunday between 10 AM and 5 PM on a sunny day. Make sure it's not Winter.

6 hearts: must have seen the previous event. Go to the library/museum any day except Sunday between 10 AM and 3 PM on a sunny day. Make sure it's not Winter.

6 hearts part two: go to the museum/library again after the previous library event. Make sure you have one empty slot in your inventory.

8 hearts: go to the beach between 7 PM and 11 PM. Make sure you have the item from the previous event in your inventory. The weather and season don't matter.
[b][i]*SIDE NOTE: (explanation about the picture item. Just open, I'm putting this in spoiler to save space)
[/i][/b][spoiler]So after you get the picture item, you have two choices: give it to him directly or proceed to view the event. I'm just adding this to have fun with the picture. One thing you need to note is after you give him the picture, there's no way to gain it back again (I know, I'm sorry) and it's not counted as the heart event, so if you lose the picture, the 8 hearts event cannot be done (Suguru's response dialogue after you show him the picture doesn't count as a heart event). So one way to do both (the event and see the special dialogue) is by downloading a mod called [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]. It allows you to spawn the item as many times as you like, and you can even spawn Suguru's spouse frame from there too! :D[/spoiler]

10 hearts: impossible to miss! He will visit you in your farmhouse at 6.10 AM to tell you something.

About the picture... (might be a spoiler? IDK)
[spoiler]You can view the "fallen picture" once you marry him in his spouse room. But adding a custom tile action takes time and STORAGE SPACE to make dll which my rusty old laptop could not do. Sooo... I have put in the tile action in his spouse room, and you can view it, ONLY IF you have the mod: Ridgeside Village installed because it's using the tile action from there. This is optional! But hey, it spices up his spouse room... haha... I'll figure out how to do it on my own when I have the time, more patience, brain capacity and storage space... cries...[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/7bdkbfv.png[/img]

1. Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]3. Install this mod
4. Unzip the folder
5. Look inside and move the one that has [CP] as title into your Stardew Valley mods folder
6. Run the game using ﻿[i]Stardew Modding API
[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/tm0FmhQ.png[/img]﻿

This is [b]optional [/b]but I recommend these mods:
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/239]NPC MAP LOCATIONS[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33462545]Bouhm[/url] since he has quite a complicated schedule -- so you can locate him in-game!
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4]CJB Cheats Menu[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1552317]Pathoschild[/url] to play with his heart (literally) -- to see his special dialogues in every season, especially those requiring heart count [size=1](see notes in mod folder for further info!)
[/size]- Now that he has heart events, I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8505]Event Lookup[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/69153238]shekurika[/url] to track the events!
- I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21924]Heart Event Helper[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/13808845]BussinBungus[/url] to see which responses affect the friendship.
- Also recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]. Other than it's an amazing mod as I've been having fun with it, I'm also using one of the custom tile actions—more about this in the spoiler tab inside the heart events description.﻿﻿﻿﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to spawn event-related items such as the 'Fallen Picture' required for Suguru's 8 hearts event in case you lost it or accidentally gave it to Suguru. Also used to add Suguru's spouse frame to your home!
